scope: Lysates were immunoprecipitated using protein G beads (Sigma-Aldrich) coated with unconjugated anti-biotin antibody
The precleared lysate was collected and then incubated with the antibody-coated protein G beads overnight at 4 °C

After overnight incubation, the beads were washed 5 times with RIPA buffer and then eluted with 2× sample loading buffer containing 10 mM dithiotheitol by boiling for 10 min. Eluted proteins were resolved by SDS-PAGE and the resulting gel was silver stained for in-gel trypsin digestion followed by proteomic MS analysis.
